info_clock.definition: P9 AL-CLOCK --info-clock-print (print-only): the book's member-decisions over its scored effective rebalance decisions (rows >= score_begin), whatever rate it runs (rate): name_days; fast_name_days = those whose clock (field: ea_days_since, row d, the pinned role fields; not an input of the run unless rate is info-clock-rate-v1) lies in [0, window_sessions]; missing_name_days = those whose clock is NaN; fast_share = fast / name_days; planned_turnover = sum of |planned - current| weights over the name-days (planned: the book's plan after DECIDE, locate block included; current: its weight entering DECIDE); fast_planned_turnover = its part on fast name-days; turnover_share = fast / planned_turnover (null when a denominator is 0); theta_fast = 1 - 2^(-cadence/5) and theta_slow = .05 are info-clock-rate-v1's rates at this run's cadence
